supersession.scope: Supersedes M427 r2 only for M426 seed-fusion semantic executability and its 437640532-cycle/1.695794x interpretation. The r2 independent row/cycle recomputation and resource-fairness findings remain valid.

verdict.reason: The frozen M108/M118/M120 recurrence retains old PSUM across all 432 partitions and accepts only old_psum + update_delta. M426 instead specifies a mux that replaces old_psum with reconstructed PWP on the first correction, computing PWP + correction rather than old_psum + PWP + correction. Full runtime decoding finds prior PSUM semantics on 99.6100% of positive-residual PWP rows. No already-charged local accumulator/merge or three-operand path exists.

frozen_semantics.loop_order: sample, operator, W64 raster window, partition

cycle_consequence.interpretation: With only the frozen two-input accumulator adder, a fail-closed schedule can fuse only rows whose base is still empty, retaining merely 362552 cycles (0.0683%) versus dual. A generic local accumulate-and-merge schedule returns exactly to the dual total.

dual_coread_independent_judgment.reason: Direct low8/high4 co-read still supplies one exact update_delta operand to the existing old_psum + delta recurrence; unlike seed fusion, it does not require three operands.
dual_coread_independent_judgment.retained_boundary: Standalone RTL plus macro/interconnect throughput-area Pareto only; no headline or system claim.

findings.title: M426 seed fusion drops the prior cross-partition PSUM
findings.detail: M118 clears row_valid only at window start, captures row_valid as the base-valid bit on every accepted update, and computes base + delta. M108 commits only after partition 431. M426's mux replaces that base with PWP on the first correction. Across the frozen runtime, 11575447/11620766 positive PWP rows already have an active earlier partition.
findings.required_repair: Revoke the 437640532-cycle/1.695794x executable claim. Restart only with either a charged 96-lane three-operand/pre-adder/compressor path or an explicit local-accumulator plus global-merge schedule, followed by a frozen recurrence/value miter and new replay.

findings.title: A repaired generic fusion datapath is a new architecture, not a mux patch
findings.detail: old_psum + PWP + correction needs three operands. A pre-adder/compressor adds 96-lane arithmetic and routing; a local accumulator needs state and a charged merge.
findings.required_repair: Freeze new ports, widths, overflow semantics, latency, stalls, and merge ownership before any new cycle credit. Run directed plus frozen-runtime VCS, DC/STA, Formality, and value equality.

findings.title: Dual co-read remains outside a common resource envelope
findings.detail: Its arithmetic is exact, but it activates 144 logical PWP bytes/cycle versus the 96-byte one-port strong-zero reference. M427 r2's K2 sensitivity remains faster than dual and nearly equal to the now-revoked fused number.
findings.required_repair: Implement dual and a common-area/bandwidth K2 reference, then report throughput-area and throughput-power Pareto.

findings.title: Physical memory/interconnect and power remain unclosed
findings.detail: M412 excludes descriptor/PWP SRAM macros, memory wires, clock tree, and compute backend. The separate low/high ports are logical inputs, not a macro-inclusive physical result.
findings.required_repair: Bind actual low/high macros, synthesize the reconstruction/accumulator path, and run real-SAIF PTPX before physical performance or energy claims.

findings.title: Empty-base-only fusion is measurable but immaterial
findings.detail: Only 45319 positive PWP rows have no prior active partition, preserving 362552 cycles or 0.0683% versus dual.
findings.required_repair: Do not spend the DATE critical path on an empty-base-only RTL unless it is nearly free after dual implementation.

findings.title: Static source absence is not a proof of all future integration choices
findings.detail: This audit proves the frozen M401/M405/M412/M426 model has no charged merge path. A future integration may add one, but must be treated as a new design identity.
findings.required_repair: Keep new architecture evidence and contracts separate from M426.

findings.title: Scope remains four frozen H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators
findings.detail: Neither surviving dual cycles nor any redesigned fusion result is a full-network speedup.
findings.required_repair: Preserve scope labels and the system/headline false boundary.

p0_p1_change_from_m427r2.change: P0 +1; score -24. P1 count stays 3 but seed-fusion value-proof wording is strengthened into a new-architecture gate after the P0 revocation.

required_next_gates: Stop M426 seed-fusion RTL as specified and remove 1.695794x from every candidate/headline table.
Proceed only with standalone dual co-read RTL/value/protocol proof under throughput-area labeling.
Build a resource-matched K2/common-area reference before comparative admission.
If generic three-operand fusion is revisited, issue a new milestone/contract and charge its arithmetic, timing, state, and memory ports.
Run DC/STA/Formality and macro/SAIF/PTPX for the surviving dual path.

claim_boundary.allowed_now: Independent semantic P0 finding plus exact full-runtime prior-base classification; dual co-read remains a standalone architectural opportunity.
